name: Necklace of Foresight banishes itself to Glimpse 4
notes: Necklace of Foresight's element is NORM, so no lineage patch is needed. As a REGALIA,ITEM (a Material-deck card type), it is seeded directly onto the field rather than played from hand, same pattern as worn-gearblade-durability-prevent -- this fixture is about its activated ability, not its materialize flow, so the memory-cost payment mechanic is out of scope. Activating resolves an MZREARRANGE decision (the Glimpse 4 reorder), answered by putting all 4 revealed cards back on top in the same order.
